summary: Anderson County Park confirmed on the county's own pages (curl refused, headless read): 40 short-term water + 30/50 A sites $30-35 (stored confirmed), season Mar 1-Dec 1, online-only on Bonfire, 14-day limit; derived max_rig 33 (camper review) cleared; lakefront UPGRADE LEAD for the north-end C-road sites; phone change suggested.
flags: WATERFRONT UPGRADE LEAD lakeview -> lakefront (flag only): the stored evidence ('RV loop ... set back ~60-80m behind a developed day-use swim beach') was read at the pin, which sits ~110 m SE of the camping loops at a road junction. The operator map puts the short-term C-road sites on the lake side of the road from the campers' swim area/playground north to the road's end (unstarred C12-C22 there). On Esri imagery the north end of that shore (pads ~36.28856-36.28860,-84.03269 to -84.03280 and a trailer pad at ~36.28821,-84.03263) sits on open mowed grass ~13-27 m from the high-water/vegetation line, north of (not behind) the campers' swim beach. 3DEP: pads 313.8-315.1 m, grass edge 310.3-311.4 m (Norris June summer target ~1,020 ft = 310.9 m), so the pads are ~2.5-4 m above summer pool over an even 12-20% grass slope - not a 30-degree bank; a kayak can be carried down. I could not tie each pad on imagery to a map number with certainty, so the site numbers are the map's (C12-C22 region), and the Bonfire site list (reCAPTCHA) stayed unread. Reviewer decides; if upgraded, evidence should name the north-end C sites, not the swim beach.

PHONE 865-494-5059 -> 865-253-3364 (suggested): every page footer gives 'Anderson County Park System | 865-253-3364 (call or text)' and the reservations page says to 'call the park office at 865-253-3364'; 865-494-5059 appears only as a second number on the 2023 map.

SITES: max_rig_ft 33 (derived from a 'firsthand review' in the note) cleared - no park page states a length. The park also has 30 long-term sites ($427.31, period not stated) beside the 40 short-term ones: local park, so the long-stay tests don't apply, but nightly sites are 40 of 70.
